comp-mp6v1egq6.html:
As a Pre-sales Engineer at DataVision, you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI technology and customer success. You will support our sales team by demonstrating the value of our AI-driven solutions, preparing technical proposals, and helping potential clients understand how our offerings—such as FLAGIT and MASKIT—can solve real-world problems in industries like insurance, healthcare, and industrial automation.

 

Your Role and Responsibilities

  • Understanding of AI and computer vision concepts (e.g., image classification, object detection, deep learning pipelines)

  • Pre-sales or customer-facing technical experience

  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and deploying AI models in production environments

  • Linux administration and scripting for demo environments

  • API integration and familiarity with RESTful services

 

Position Requirements

  • Strong experience with the following:

    • Linux administration

    • Virtualization technologies, primarily containers (e.g., Docker)

    • Remote device management, including updates and monitoring

​

  • Experience with the following is an advantage:

    • Demonstrating AI or SaaS platforms to enterprise clients

    • Working knowledge of Docker and container-based deployments

    • Familiarity with insurance or industrial sectors (e.g., claims automation, visual inspections, regulatory constraints)

    • Tools like Jupyter, OpenCV, or TensorFlow for AI demos​

​

​

Minimum Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience)

  • 2+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions engineering, or technical consulting role

  • Excellent communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus

 

What We Offer

  • Inspiring a work environment within a collaborative team.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement in IT.

  • Flexible working hours, home office options, and 5 weeks of vacation.

  • 3 extra days off for personal matters, such as administrative tasks or sick days.

  • Regular grill parties on the company terrace.

  • Competitive compensation based on performance.​

​

If you want to work on projects where business, technology, and data meet, send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.

​
